class.name: LuaCabinTextureNode
class.brief_description: A Lua script drawing a screen of a driver's cab.
class.description: A [LuaTextureNode] that sits under a cab's [Cabin3D]. Its script gets the cab's vehicle and cabin after the drawing ([code]local drawing, vehicle, cabin = ...[/code]), nil outside a cab. With [member cabin_implementation] the script reaches the cab's controls through [code]reloaded.cabin[/code] too.

members.member: How the script reaches the cabs ([method ScenarioScriptServer.context_attach_cabin_implementation]); none leaves [code]reloaded.cabin[/code] without a cab layer.
